subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Computers would replace the ______ technique of creating an image on paper, transferring it to cells and again onto film.
solution:
Here, the correct answer is** "archaic."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The reason to use **"archaic"** in the blank is to convey that the technique being described is outdated, old-fashioned, or no longer in common use. (वर्णित तकनीक पुरानी है, पुराने ज़माने की है, या अब आम उपयोग में नहीं है)
 
• Using **"archaic" **suggests that computers would replace a method that was once employed but is now considered obsolete, especially in the context of image creation and reproduction.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

Correct sentence: *Computers would replace the **archaic**__ technique of creating an image on paper, transferring it to cells and again onto film. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Austere: **very simple; without decoration. (अति साधारण और सरल; आडंबरहीन, मितव्‍ययी)
 
• **Audacious: **willing to take risks or do something shocking. (ख़तरा उठाने या स्‍तब्‍धकारी कार्य करने को तैयार; निर्भीक, निडर)
 
• **Assuage: **to make an unpleasant feeling less strong. (प्रतिकूल भावना आदि की तीक्ष्‍णता को कम करना)
